prospective_paper_protocol.effective_from: first scanner decision timestamp after this research commit
prospective_paper_protocol.baseline: READY-only existing scanner observations, no dispatch
prospective_paper_protocol.research_arm: PR63 offline observation-only; no READY promotion or paper entry without separate pre-registered rule
prospective_paper_protocol.entry: First time-stamped authentic L2 ask book at or after READY decision, within 600s; compute 1000 TRY marketable hypothetical VWAP from actual ask depth; no data=>UNKNOWN, proved insufficient depth=>NO_FILL
prospective_paper_protocol.exit: First time-stamped authentic L2 bid VWAP at/after stop or TP1 trigger as observed in ordered bid snapshots; otherwise first valid bid at 6h within 600s; missing path or ambiguous ordering=>UNKNOWN
prospective_paper_protocol.stop_and_tp: Use frozen READY stop and TP1; no retroactive threshold change; TP2 recorded only descriptively
prospective_paper_protocol.slippage: VWAP from as-of L2; separate stress scenario additional 0.10% adverse per side, not claimed observed
prospective_paper_protocol.net_formula: quantity=1000/(entry_ask_vwap*(1+fee)); net_try=quantity*exit_bid_vwap*(1-fee)-1000; only with complete execution-model evidence
prospective_paper_protocol.caveat: A modelled marketable order is not a real exchange fill; no guaranteed fill or profit.
